originalTitle: Treasury yields surge after Bessent’s beefed-up buyback operation fails to calm market
summary: The Treasury market’s painful rout intensified Thursday, after an underwhelming auction of 30-year U.S. government debt and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s first beefed-up buyback operation.
content: The Treasury market’s painful rout intensified Thursday, after an underwhelming auction of 30-year U.S. government debt and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s first beefed-up buyback operation.
chineseTitle: Bessent加强回购操作未能安抚市场后，国债收益率飙升
chineseSummary: 在30年期美国国债拍卖惨淡以及财政部长斯科特·贝森特首次加强回购操作之后，美国国债市场的痛苦溃败周四加剧。
